title: Enchanted Board Game Rally
description: A chess board serves as a miniature race track where a toy car must navigate between chess pieces to collect magical fish. The player drives the toy car across the board, picking up barramundi fish tokens that spawn at random squares, while avoiding chess pieces that periodically shift positions as obstacles.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements an interactive board game rally. Load ABeautifulGame.glb as the central game board scaled to fill the scene. Load BarramundiFish.glb scaled down to roughly chess-piece size and clone it to create 3 collectible fish tokens placed at random unoccupied squares on the board. Load ToyCar.glb scaled to fit on a single board square as the player vehicle. Camera setup: use a perspective camera at a 45-degree overhead angle looking down at the board, with OrbitControls limited to rotation only (no zoom or pan). Add ambient light intensity 0.6 and a directional light casting soft shadows from above. Interactions: (1) Player clicks a Start Game button in an HTML overlay to begin. (2) Arrow keys or WASD move the toy car one square at a time across the 8x8 grid with smooth tweened movement taking 300ms per step. (3) The car must stay within board bounds; invalid moves are rejected with a brief red flash on the HUD. (4) When the car reaches a square containing a fish, the fish plays a spin animation, scales to zero, and the score increments in a HUD counter. (5) After each fish is collected, a random chess piece on the board glows red and shifts to a new random square with a slide animation, acting as a moving obstacle. (6) If the car moves onto a square occupied by a chess piece, the car bounces back to its previous square and a life is lost from 3 total lives shown as heart icons. (7) Collecting all 3 fish triggers a victory state where remaining chess pieces animate upward and a confetti particle system bursts from the board center. (8) Losing all 3 lives shows a Game Over overlay with a Restart button that resets car position, fish spawns, and piece positions. Display a move counter and elapsed timer in the HUD. All state transitions must validate car grid position and occupancy before executing.
